SELECT
    date,
    platform,
    ad_id,
    account_id,
    campaign_id,
    ad_group_id,
    ad_name,
    ad_status,
    campaign_name,
    ad_group_name,
    currency,
    spend,
    impressions,
    clicks
FROM `marketing_dev`.`staging_staging`.`stg_facebook_ads`

UNION ALL

SELECT
    date,
    platform,
    ad_id,
    account_id,
    campaign_id,
    ad_group_id,
    ad_name,
    ad_status,
    campaign_name,
    ad_group_name,
    currency,
    spend,
    impressions,
    clicks
FROM `marketing_dev`.`staging_staging`.`stg_snapchat_ads`
) SELECT
    date,
    platform,
    campaign_id,
    campaign_name,
    ad_group_id,
    ad_group_name,
    ad_id,
    ad_name,
    ad_status,
    account_id,
    currency,
    spend,
    impressions,
    clicks,
    -- Business Metrics
    CASE WHEN impressions > 0 THEN CAST(clicks AS DOUBLE) / impressions ELSE 0 END AS ctr,
    CASE WHEN clicks > 0 THEN spend / clicks ELSE 0 END AS cpc,
    CASE WHEN impressions > 0 THEN (spend / impressions) * 1000 ELSE 0 END AS cpm
FROM __dbt__cte__int_marketing_ads

model_runs.name: stg_facebook_ads
model_runs.compiled_code:
SELECT
    s.ad_date AS date,
    'facebook' AS platform,
    CAST(s.ad_id AS STRING) AS ad_id,
    CAST(s.account_id AS STRING) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.campaign_id AS STRING) AS campaign_id,
    CAST(a.ad_group_id AS STRING) AS ad_group_id,
    a.ad_name,
    a.ad_status,
    c.campaign_name,
    ag.ad_group_name,
    ac.account_name,
    ac.ad_currency_code AS currency,
    s.ad_spend AS spend,
    COALESCE(s.ad_impressions, 0) AS impressions,
    COALESCE(s.ad_clicks, 0) AS clicks,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS _loaded_at
FROM `marketing_dev`.`raw`.`facebook_ads_stats` s
LEFT JOIN `marketing_dev`.`raw`.`facebook_ad` a
    ON s.ad_id = a.ad_id
LEFT JOIN `marketing_dev`.`raw`.`facebook_campaign` c
    ON a.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN `marketing_dev`.`raw`.`facebook_adgroup` ag
    ON a.ad_group_id = ag.ad_group_id
LEFT JOIN `marketing_dev`.`raw`.`facebook_account` ac
    ON s.account_id = ac.account_id
